title: Return History Casebook for Deposit Pre-Order Cancellation Charges — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders
content:
**Governing rule.** When a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order is cancelled at will, the return authorizations opened on the customer's profile in the last 12 months adjust the cancellation charge, whatever became of those returns:

| Return authorizations opened, last 12 months | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 1.2 |
| One up to 2 (fewer than 3) | 1.1 |
| None | 1.0 |

The returns counted are the customer's Returns & Exchanges return authorizations, each counted by the date it was opened. The multiplier applies to the cancellation charge as one more factor of the same product of the reserved price and the charge rate. It applies before the cap at the deposit held and before the rounding to the cent, both of which apply to the whole product.

**Cases (hypothetical)**

| Case | Return authorizations opened in the last 12 months | Outcome of those returns | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 0 (one opened 14 months ago) | — | 1.0 |
| B | 1 | Refunded | 1.1 |
| C | 2 | One rejected, one withdrawn | 1.1 |
| D | 3 | All refunded | 1.2 |
| E | 5 | Mixed | 1.2 |

**Reading the cases.** Case C counts the rejected and the withdrawn return alike, because the count takes every authorization opened, whatever became of it. In case A the single return lies outside the 12 months, so the count is none.
